question: If the digest Kar's direct line reads is re-laid so each fact sits on its own labelled line and the build list names newest, oldest and order, does his 7B answer more of the same questions right?
why: The watch (sealed cd4913b) found the misses are reading misses on crowded lines, and a playbook rule telling the model to read carefully did not cut them (11 repeats with it vs 10 without). This changes the input, not the instructions.

arms.old: the pinned system prompt exactly as the watch ran it
arms.layout: the same prompt with only its digest re-laid by layout.mjs

design.sameIn: both arms: the frozen watch route, greedy decoding, the brain pinned, no playbook, the 20 held-out questions of the watch, "Answer in one short line."
design.layout: layout.mjs relayout(): the ESTATE line and every recent build split into one clause per line at dashes, semicolons, middle dots, colons, commas, pluses, "but", "vs" and parentheses; the builds numbered #1 newest to #N oldest, each naming the build just before it. Nothing added that the digest did not say.

rules.rule: every fact token of the old prompt is still in the re-laid one (decided at seal)
the layout arm answers at least 2 more of the 20 right than the old arm
the layout arm has at least 2 fewer wrong-number misses than the old arm
every question the old arm answers right, the layout arm answers right
the old arm gives exactly the replies the watch's without-arm gave (greedy is greedy — else the noise floor is not zero)

shipRule: the live digest switches to the new layout only if more-right AND no-regression both pass; otherwise the finding is recorded and the live digest stays as it is

predictions.more-right: unsure — the reading misses are the layout's target, but some clauses lose their label when split ("1 of 4" on its own line)
predictions.fewer-wrong-number: pass, leaning — 8 of the old arm's 10 misses are wrong-number
predictions.no-regression: fail, likely — the prompt changes in 700 characters and greedy outputs move everywhere

honesty: Kar saw these 20 questions when he wrote them for the watch, and before he wrote layout.mjs. The layout was not tuned against them: it was written from the miss SHAPES the watch named, and sealed on first output without a dry run on the questions.
One run of 20 questions on one 7B is a small test: a difference of one or two answers can be noise in what the changed text does to the model.
